title: dedicated: autoscaler burst controls, throughput guarantees, and utilization reporting
author: Diego Ramos
description: Adds an improved burst control and throughput guarantee model to the Dedicated autoscaler plus richer utilization reporting for fleet operators. Motivation: customers using Dedicated have requested tighter controls on short-term burst capacity (to avoid noisy neighbors) and explicit throughput guarantees for tenant SLAs while retaining efficient packing when under normal load. This PR introduces a token-bucket based burst limiter at the fleet and tenant level, a configurable refill_rate and max_burst_tokens, and enforcement hooks in the scheduler; Policy API: extend Dedicated autoscaler policy schema with optional fields throughput_guarantee_rps and burst_capacity_tokens and validation; Reporting: new Prometheus metrics dedicated_fleet_utilization_1m, dedicated_fleet_utilization_5m, dedicated_tenant_burst_tokens_remaining, autoscaler_throughput_guarantee_violation_count and a Console dashboard; Rollout/flags: feature flag dedicated.autoscaler.v2 gating enforcement, default off for existing tenants, migration CLI to preview recommended params; Tests and perf: unit and integration tests for burst scenarios and microbenchmarks showing <2% added p95 latency with net token-cost reduction under moderate load. Backwards compatibility: policies without new fields behave identically. Rollout: canary in non-prod, staged tests with 3 customers, monitor dedicated_fleet_utilization_5m and throughput violation counts, then full release. Related: ENG-4821 autoscaler design, ENG-4902 dashboard work.
